acceptanceCriteria: An explicit opt-in clean-Go-range CLI runs the bounded selected mutant set on changed lines, preserves default prove semantics, and never runs automatically from a hook.
Weak versus strengthened boundary tests produce actual survivor versus killed evidence with immutable path/blob/span bindings, including mixed kill/survivor observations.

Baseline failure, missing sandbox, malformed inputs, unsupported language, budget exhaustion and interruption preserve named NOT_RUN or partial observations and ordinary descendant cleanup evidence; bounded completion never means exhaustive coverage or correctness.
Stable TAT-V0 requirements, focused regressions, actual CLI qualification, independent review and combined dogfood evidence are retained; native completion waits for required integration.
body:
